description: Web page extractor for AI agents: fetch any public URL and get clean Markdown, the page title and all links as JSON, with scripts, styles and menus removed. url is the page address (https://...). Private or internal addresses are blocked; pages over 2 MB or slower than 10 seconds are rejected and you are not charged. Use to read one HTML web page as Markdown together with all its links. Instead, use `markdown` ($0.002) for PDFs and Office documents too. Answers may be cached for up to 10 minutes. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.

url.description: Full http(s) address of a public web page.
